observations: Photo 0 shows a rectangular solar PV panel with a grid of blue cells and a white frame.
No visible brand/model text is readable on the panel in the photo.
No label/rating plate (watts, voltage, current, cell count) is visible in the photo.
The panel appears to be a used/installed unit (no obvious new packaging; surface looks like it has been handled).

claims.claim: It's original 650 Watts 144 cell direct Canadian used solar panel
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a rating label or any readable text confirming wattage (650W) or cell count (144) or origin (Canadian).
Seller text is vague; photo 0 does not show performance/testing.

risks.risk: Wattage/cell count may not match the claimed 650W/144 cells (could be a different size/rating).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s junction box label/rating plate showing Wp, Voc, Isc, and cell count/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used solar panel with unknown rating (worst-case: lower wattage than claimed).

risks.risk: Used condition may include microcracks, delamination, or damaged cells that reduce output.
risks.proof: Photos of the full panel front and back (including frame corners) plus an IV curve test or at least a power test reading under sun.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to meet rated output (worst-case: reduced performance).

risks.risk: Electrical condition may be faulty (bypass diode failure, open circuit, loose connections).
risks.proof: Continuity check of output leads and a multimeter reading of Voc/Isc (or a proper solar tester/IV test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/uncertain until tested.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: connector type and cable length may not match the buyer’s system.
risks.proof: Photo of the junction box and connector type (MC4 or other) and a shot showing cable length and polarity markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming buyer may need adapters/cabling.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rating label/junction box sticker showing: brand/model, Wp (watts), Voc, Isc, and cell count.
Full front and full back photos (including corners and any visible damage).
A power test/IV curve screenshot or measured Voc/Isc readings under test conditions.
Photo of the junction box and connector type (e.g., MC4) plus cable length.
response.reason: The photo shows a solar panel, but it does not provide readable rating details to confirm the claimed 650W/144-cell specification or electrical condition. Without the label and a test, the correct worst-case pricing cannot be set confidently.
